notes: The run did the substantive work well (coverage, invariants, cross-references, assumptions marked) and failed mostly on prose discipline. Two assertions deserve a second look. The only-under-docs/ assertion fails on an AGENTS.md edit that the fixture's own docs/README.md tells agents to make when the spec index changes; if the intent is 'no code touched', say 'nothing outside docs/ and AGENTS.md' or 'ticketdesk/ and tests/ untouched', otherwise the eval penalizes following the repo's rules. The five-criteria assertion bundles heading format, uniqueness, body length and Testable-lines into one pass/fail, so a single four-sentence body (CLI-010) sinks it; split body length out. check_run.py's duplicate count also misreads the repo-sanctioned TKT-014A/B/C suffixes as duplicates, so its duplicates field should not be trusted mechanically. Uncovered but observed: the agent amended CLI-001 and CLI-006 in place (changing existing stable criteria's text) rather than only appending; no assertion checks whether edits to existing criteria are flagged for sign-off, which matters in a repo whose process rule is 'never silently update a spec'.
